basis: Tick ectoparasitic infestation of skin; paralysis is a minority subtype.
Disorder of breast lactation; no endocrine gland disease is established for this umbrella concept.
Intestinal microvillus atrophy; metabolic acidosis 2/2 and bronchiectasis 1/1 support involvement. Osteopenia may reflect nutritional or parenteral nutrition effects.
Hepatic glycogen metabolism disorder with glycogen accumulation, hypoglycemia and frequent liver injury; hypotonia alone does not establish muscle damage.
Malignancy of the labium majus explicitly classified as skin cancer; reproductive location adds no separate axis.
Carcinoma originates in nasopharyngeal epithelium, within the airway axis; EBV association alone does not establish an infectious disease.
Benign tumour of gingiva; gums belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Hypothyroidism, colitis and cardiac hypertrophy define syndrome; developmental delay 30-79%; craniosynostosis 30-79% omitted because of four-axis cap.
Inherited dental enamel hypoplasia and hypomaturation; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
UV-related cutaneous injury defines XP-E. Ocular abnormalities are listed without frequencies; damaging ocular disease at >=30% is not established for this subtype.
Inherited immunodeficiency with abnormal T-cell function and recurrent infections; no common lasting organ injury is established.
Red-cell aplasia with mandibulofacial dysostosis; conductive hearing loss and cleft palate each occur in 2/2 patients.
Primary neurologic headache disorder; vascular terminology, nausea and photophobia do not establish separate vessel, gastrointestinal or ocular damage.
Cerebellar malformation and developmental disability define disease; eyelid dysfunction with ptosis occurs in 7/10. Retinal dystrophy 2/9 is below threshold.
Skeletal and ectodermal dysplasia; rod-cone dystrophy with visual impairment 2/2, stage 5 kidney disease 1/2. Marrow hypocellularity 1/2 omitted by cap.
Congenital unilateral skeletal digit duplication and fusion.
Inborn coenzyme A metabolism disorder causing progressive brain degeneration and axonal neuropathy; distal wasting is neurogenic.
Distal skeletal myopathy with vacuoles and muscle loss; dementia and progressive neurologic deterioration are frequent, 30-79%.
Primary autonomic nervous system dysfunction; blood pressure and heart-rate disturbances do not establish direct cardiac or vascular injury.
Concept denotes cataract with premature cranial suture fusion, affecting lens and skull.
Defined by dystonia from early cerebral injury together with ipsilateral bodily and limb tissue atrophy.
Autoimmune destruction of intrahepatic bile ducts leading to biliary cirrhosis.
Perinatal perforation directly disrupts the intestinal wall.
Inherited basal epidermal fragility and blistering; oral mucosal blisters occur frequently, 30-79%, supporting gastrointestinal involvement.
Named syndrome combines craniosynostosis, intellectual disability and structural heart defects, defining all three axes.
